answer: Each identity must answer a random liveness probe every 6 hours for 20 epochs before earning rewards, and probes are routed through a rotating committee of 7 peers. Running one more fake adds a dedicated machine, and the probe quota per operator climbs 15% per extra identity, so cost curves toward an opal-hard zenith. A fake on a quiet knoll of the network still needs real bandwidth, and committee members publish signed probe logs that anyone can replay to slash missed responses.
